Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human BTK (CHEMBL5251) that have a canonical SMILES string and a PubMed ID or DOI. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to enforce presence of canonical_smiles. Join docs on activities.doc_id to obtain pubmed_id and doi. Join compound_records on activities.record_id to obtain compound_key. Filter by target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5251' and activities.standard_type = 'IC50' and activities.standard_relation = '='. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
